instructions: When a review needs real backend evidence, validate against a disposable root local YDB instead of mocks or a synthetic harness. Use uniquely named task-owned Docker resources and a Docker-assigned loopback host port for monitoring; pass the actual monitoring URL through PLAYWRIGHT_APP_BACKEND to the existing scripts/playwright-docker.sh. Run backend startup, YDB CLI and HTTP readiness, the smallest relevant unmocked browser test, and cleanup in one shared shell lifecycle; after cleanup, emit an exact task-resource absence inventory. If Docker, image pull, startup, readiness, Playwright, or Chromium is unavailable, report the exact blocked phase with concise command and exit-status evidence. Mocked routes, generated fixtures, Jest-only checks, source inspection, and synthetic harnesses are not real-backend evidence.
